steps.text: Add a cube for the table top (Shift+A ▸ Mesh ▸ Cube) and rename it 'Top' (F2).
Make the top 1.2 × 0.8 × 0.05 m: N sidebar ▸ Item ▸ Dimensions.
Add a cylinder leg named 'Leg', about 0.05 × 0.05 × 0.72 m.
Stand the leg on the floor: move it up (G Z) until its bottom is at 0.
Make four legs (Shift+D to duplicate, then move each to a corner).
Rest the top on the legs: its bottom should touch their tops (about 0.72 m up).
Round the top's edges: Modifiers ▸ Add ▸ Generate ▸ Bevel.
Give the top a material: Properties ▸ Material ▸ New, then pick a wood colour.
Add a camera (Shift+A ▸ Camera) and look through it (Numpad 0).
